title: Full-stack developer (TypeScript + .NET)
summary: TypeScript in the browser and C# on the server: a typed front end, an ASP.NET Core API with EF Core behind it, auth across both, and a pipeline that ships them.
outcome: Ready to take a feature from the UI to the database: the component, the endpoint, the migration, the auth check and the pipeline.

stages.title: JavaScript and TypeScript
stages.why: The front end runs JavaScript, and teams write it as TypeScript so the compiler catches what tests miss. Values, functions, async and the type system first.
stages.milestone: Writes typed, async TypeScript and reads compiler errors to their cause

stages.title: The browser and the UI
stages.why: Classes, patterns, the DOM and events are what React and Next.js are built on. Understanding them makes framework bugs explainable instead of magic.
stages.milestone: Builds a typed task board core that a React front end can sit on

stages.title: C# for the server
stages.why: The same ideas in a second language, with a stricter compiler. Types, collections, LINQ and async are what the API layer is made of.
stages.milestone: Writes async C# with LINQ comfortably

stages.title: The API and its data
stages.why: The back half of every feature: endpoints, dependency injection, SQL and EF Core, ending with two real APIs you grow stage by stage.
stages.milestone: Builds a CRUD API with EF Core that a TypeScript client consumes

stages.title: HTTP and auth across both sides
stages.why: Full-stack bugs live at the seam: CORS, cookies versus tokens, redirects and OAuth flows. Knowing both ends is the point of the role.
stages.milestone: Signs users in with OpenID Connect and protects both the UI routes and the API

stages.title: Ship it
stages.why: A feature is done when it is merged and deployed. Git for the team, containers for both halves, and a pipeline that builds and tests them.
stages.milestone: Can ship a containerised API with CI, next to its front end

stages.title: Design that lasts
stages.why: Full-stack codebases grow fast in two languages at once. Readable code, SOLID where it pays and testable seams keep them changeable.
stages.milestone: Keeps a two-language codebase tested and easy to change
